usedFor: DocuMocu builds documents, and “Create a Document” and “Create a Recipient” set up the file and who receives it.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create a Category” in DocuMocu
bestTemplate.why: The category gives new documents a place to be filed from the start.

watchOut: “Archive a Document” moves a document to the archive, and it can be restored later.
